[m1] USER: Why is the CI build so slow lately? Don't change anything, just tell me.

[m2] AGENT: The build got slower because the e2e job stopped using the dependency cache on 3 November: the cache key includes the lockfile hash, and the lockfile now changes on every run. Install went from 40 seconds to about 6 minutes. I have not changed anything.
